wins: Identified reachable services (HTTP on 80, SSH on 22) and collected service banners for prioritization
Extracted configuration artifact from web root that hints at possible credentials (reward achieved 70 via info gathering)
fails: Failed to escalate privileges or achieve mission objective despite multiple mentor hints due to lack of valid credentials
No successful lateral movement; engagement terminated before exploitation phase
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance was thorough enough to map the service landscape, but the campaign stalled in the exploitation phase because credentials were never obtained and privilege escalation attempts were not pursued effectively.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Persistence on brute-forcing SSH without prior credential harvesting led to extended stalls with no progress
Process automation repeatedly attempted exploitation before thorough enumeration of web directories, causing missed opportunity to discover backup creds

skill_cards.if_condition: When HTTP (port 80) responds with HTML content and robots.txt exists
skill_cards.then_action: Use gobuster with default wordlist to enumerate directories and capture credentials clues

skill_cards.if_condition: When SSH port 22 is open and banner indicates OpenSSH
skill_cards.then_action: Launch nmap NSE ssh-auth-methods and ssh-brute scripts to enumerate allowed auth mechanisms

skill_cards.if_condition: When web enumeration discovers config files with credential placeholders
skill_cards.then_action: Extract candidate credentials and attempt login near real-time via curl/HTTP POST

memory_ops.reason: Reliable discovery of directories and asset clues increased reconnaissance depth
SSH enumeration yielded authentication method info that can guide future exploitation

next_experiments.title: Integrate credential harvesting with web enumeration
next_experiments.description: After gobuster reveals config/snippets, script extraction of username/password candidates and feed them directly into authentication attempts instead of static lists

next_experiments.title: Automate SSH auth-methods to focus brute forcing
next_experiments.description: Use ssh-auth-methods results to limit brute-force to supported algorithms and rotate wordlists to avoid lockouts

next_experiments.title: Validate lateral movement post-authentication
next_experiments.description: Once valid SSH credentials exist, immediately deploy mimikatz-like token harvesting or sudo enumeration to prepare escalation path
